aiDirector.title: AI director
aiDirector.priceHelp: A message holds up to this while it runs and is charged only what it used. Paid steps like storyboards and videos are priced on their own before they run.
aiDirector.localTitle: The AI director works on cloud projects
aiDirector.localBody: Save this project to OpenNan to use it. Your project stays on this device until you do.
aiDirector.signedOutTitle: Sign in to use the AI director
aiDirector.signedOutBody: The AI director edits your cloud project on OpenNan.
aiDirector.empty: Ask the director to edit this project: trim scenes, add titles, plan a story, draw storyboards.
aiDirector.emptyExample: Try “Make scene 2 shorter and add a title card”.
aiDirector.budgetNote: With a budget, the director runs paid steps up to that much in one message without asking.
aiDirector.statusLimit: Stopped at the most one message can do
aiDirector.statusFailed: The director couldn't finish this message
aiDirector.undoAiTitle: Undo what this message changed (one step)
aiDirector.proposalBlocked: Studio won't run this step: it isn't one of this project's steps.
aiDirector.taskHolds: Holds up to {usd} while it runs
aiDirector.busyElsewhere: The director is working on this project on another device.
aiDirector.errBusy: The director is still working on this project: wait or stop it.
aiDirector.errUnavailable: The AI director isn't available right now. Storyboards and Script to video still work.
aiDirector.errRate: Too many messages at once: try again in {seconds} s.
aiDirector.errRateNoTime: Too many messages at once: try again in a minute.
aiDirector.errPermission: This sign-in can't use the AI director. Sign in with OpenNan again.
aiDirector.errNotFound: This project isn't on OpenNan anymore.
aiDirector.errSignedOut: Sign in with OpenNan to use the AI director.
aiDirector.errNetwork: Can't reach OpenNan. Check your connection and try again.
aiDirector.errDropped: The connection dropped, so the director stopped.
aiDirector.errServer: Something went wrong on OpenNan. Try again.
aiDirector.errPrice: The price can't be read right now, so this step can't run yet. Try again in a moment.
aiDirector.notEnoughMessage: Not enough credits: a message holds up to {usd} while it runs.
aiDirector.notEnoughStep: Not enough credits: this step holds up to {usd} while it runs.
aiDirector.boardIntro: Each scene's storyboard is drawn on OpenNan, one panel per shot. Every drawing is priced before it runs.
aiDirector.boardEmpty: This project has no scenes yet. Plan them in Script to video, or ask the director.
aiDirector.scriptIntro: Paste a script or load subtitles. Studio cuts a script into subtitles, one per sentence.
aiDirector.scriptPlaceholder: Night falls on the town. A car waits under the bridge…
aiDirector.planIntro: OpenNan plans one scene per subtitle, in the style you ask for.
aiDirector.storyboardsIntro: Draw every scene's storyboard, or pick scenes on the Storyboards board.
aiDirector.videosIntro: Render each scene as a video. Pick the model and quality; each scene is priced before it runs.
aiDirector.reviewIntro: The scenes are on your timeline. Each result is one undo step.
aiDirector.errPriceChanged: The price went up to ≈ {usd}, so nothing ran. Run it again to accept it.
aiDirector.scriptConflict: The script was changed elsewhere since you opened it.
aiDirector.proposalExpired: This proposal expired: ask the director again to see the price now.
aiDirector.errPriceRose: The price went up, so nothing ran. Run it again to see the new price.
aiDirector.errKeyReused: OpenNan had this request under another run, so nothing ran. Run it again.

share.title: Share
share.localBody: Save this project to OpenNan to share a view-only link. Local projects stay on this device.
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link: select it and copy it.
share.newLinkConfirm: The current link stops working at once. Make a new one with these options?
share.turnOffConfirm: Turn this link off? People who have it can no longer watch.
share.expiresHint: {min} to {max} days. You can turn it off any time.
share.allowDownloadHint: Viewers can save the video. Without it they can only watch.
share.nothingBody: A link plays this project's latest export. Export the current edit and share it?
share.freshExportHint: Export the current edit and make it what the link plays.
share.stepSaving: Setting it as the project's video
share.errLimit: You have 50 active share links: turn one off first.
share.errRate: Too many links made: try again in {seconds} s.
share.errRateNoTime: Too many links made: try again later.
share.errSignedOut: Sign in with OpenNan to share.
share.errNotFound: This project is no longer on OpenNan (it was deleted or moved to the trash).
share.errNetwork: Can't reach OpenNan. Check your connection and try again.
share.errServer: OpenNan couldn't do that right now. Try again in a moment.
share.errExportNoDetail: The export failed. Try again, or export from the Export dialog to see why.
share.errUpload: The upload failed, so nothing was shared. Try again.
share.errStorage: Your OpenNan storage is full, so the export can't upload. Nothing was shared.
share.errFinalVideo: OpenNan didn't take the export as this project's video. Nothing was shared.
share.savingNote: You can close this: the export is set on the project as soon as OpenNan can be reached. Open Share again to make the link.

storyFilm.title: Story film
storyFilm.storyIntro: A short animated film of the same characters, shot by shot, in a 9:16 reel. Start from a story, or copy the beats of a video. Nothing is drawn until you check the story.
storyFilm.writePlaceholder: Two strangers keep missing each other in the rain, until one of them buys an umbrella…
storyFilm.stylePlaceholder: Hand-drawn ink lines, flat colour, soft overcast light…
storyFilm.draftUnavailable: The story writer runs on OpenNan. Sign in, or start blank and write the shots yourself.
storyFilm.draftProblems: The draft did not read as a story. Try again, or start blank:
storyFilm.copyIntro: Studio looks at the video's frames and writes a story with the same beats and feel. By default it makes a new cast and title, so the film is yours to publish.
storyFilm.copyNoVideos: No videos in Media yet: upload one or paste a link.
storyFilm.copyOriginal: New cast and title (keeps the beats)
storyFilm.copyKeep: Keep the cast (only for my own video)
storyFilm.copyNoFrames: This browser could not read the video's frames. Try another file.
storyFilm.edLook: Look (what never changes: build, hair, clothes, colours)
storyFilm.edFrame: The still (who is where, doing what)
storyFilm.edMotion: What moves (it must match the still)
storyFilm.castIntro: One design sheet per character. Check each one: every keyframe is drawn from these.
storyFilm.shotsIntro: One keyframe per shot, drawn from its cast's sheets and the shot before it. Check each one before animating, and make the motion match what it shows.
storyFilm.animateIntro: Each keyframe becomes the first frame of its clip, without sound.
storyFilm.musicIntro: One instrumental music bed the length of the film.
storyFilm.timelineIntro: Puts the film on the timeline: a 9:16 frame, the title above the 16:9 film, the music faded in and out under it.
storyFilm.notPriced: The price could not be read. Try again in a moment.
storyFilm.changed: Text changed since it was made
storyFilm.castCheckHint: After each keyframe, a quick look compares it with the cast's sheets (hair, outfit, colours). A shot that does not match is drawn again once with the look restated; the price above counts that redraw.
storyFilm.checkUnread: The check could not tell whether the characters match. Look at it yourself.
storyFilm.chargedNote: Charged when each one finishes, refunded if it fails.
storyFilm.spent: Spent on this film so far: {usd}
